An '''intermission''' was a break between two parts of a performance. [[Bithabus]] the Mystifier's performances generally had intermissions, though during one intermission on [[Hologram Fun World]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] he was kidnapped and impersonated by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Cobak]]. He presumably continued to include intermissions in his performances after that.
